properties.summary: Only official, current facts are drawn: the 300-ft boiler stack. Block massing waits for the Design for Development approved in 2020; the 2018 Draft EIR blocks are superseded and not drawn.

properties.label: Stack
properties.name: Unit 3 Boiler Stack
properties.source: height: Potrero Power Station Mixed-Use Development Project Draft EIR, Volume 1 (Case No. 2017-011878ENV, Oct 2018), pp. 2-7 and 4.D-8 ('the reinforced concrete Boiler Stack ... at 300 feet in height'); footprint: OpenStreetMap w678950945 via Overture 2026-09-23.1
properties.note: OpenStreetMap footprint mapped at 91.44 m (300 ft), matching the Draft EIR's 300-ft Boiler Stack (pp. 2-7, 4.D-8) and its position south of the Unit 3 Power Block (Fig. 2-7).
